propositions: Four capability call sites use static cast() without runtime guards, allowing AttributeError to be silently swallowed by broad exception handlers when a transport lacks optional capability members.
The gap is masked in production by upstream capability-gating in the differ, but the second backend (DC) may legitimately omit these capabilities, making the silent skip a real defect.
Capability absence (designed skip) cannot be distinguished from capability present but raised (real failure) because both land in the same except Exception and neither is logged or alerted.

The solution adds isinstance() runtime guards at all four sites, logs INFO + alerts to bridge_alerts with distinct kinds (outbound-comment-capability-absent, outbound-link-capability-absent) for designed skips, and keeps real exceptions on the existing failure path.
